Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_Enabled_toolt: Master switch for Dynamic Horde Events. Disable this to stop all scheduled horde event timers. Use the per-event toggles below to disable only one horde type.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableNormalH: Enables the scheduled regular horde event. Cataclysm and wandering hordes have their own toggles and are not affected by this setting.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMode_t: Controls whether horde size increases over time. 1 Off disables scaling. 2 Days survived scales by survived days. 3 Months survived scales by survived months.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingInterv: How many days or months must pass before the horde size multiplier increases.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMultip: How much the horde size increases per scaling interval. Example: 25 means +25% per interval.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_ScalingMaxMul: Maximum total horde size multiplier. Example: 300 means the horde size can grow up to x3.Do not set 100. If you dont want scaling off disable it in scaling mode
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableNormalH: When enabled, zombies spawned by a normal horde keep periodically refreshing their target, aggro, and last-heard position to the selected player while they are alive. The normal attraction sound is still emitted, but this does not create extra sound pulses or cataclysm catch-up respawns.

Requires normal horde target tracking. Periodically asks spawned normal horde zombies to rebuild a path to the selected player, which can help with high fences and different floors. This uses no extra sound pulses, but can make normal hordes more direct and slightly increase server AI work.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MPAttractionD: Delay before the single attraction sound is emitted after spawning zombies in multiplayer. Values below 6 seconds may fail to attract spawned MP zombies. Increase this if the server has high load
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableMPActiv: In multiplayer, clamps normal and wandering horde spawn distance so freshly spawned zombies stay in the active simulation area and can hear the single attraction sound.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_MPActiveSpawn: MP active spawn max radius, tiles

Maximum spawn distance for normal and wandering hordes in multiplayer when active spawn clamp is enabled. Higher values can spawn zombies outside active AI range, causing them to ignore the attraction sound.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableCatacly: Enables a rare ultra-hardcore horde event with its own timer and warning indicator.
When enabled, zombies spawned by a cataclysm horde are forced to pursue the selected player directly. The cataclysm attraction sound is still emitted.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmPurs: How many in-game hours cataclysm zombies should keep directly pursuing the selected player. After this, the mod stops reinforcing the direct target.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableCatacly: Attempts to force severe weather when a cataclysm horde starts.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmWeat: How long the cataclysm weather event should last. The mod first tries a tropical storm, then falls back to storm, rain, lightning, and custom weather calls if needed.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableCatacly: Force fog and wind during cataclysm weather
Adds climate overrides on top of the tropical storm: fog, strong wind, heavy clouds and desaturation. Overrides are reset after the cataclysm weather duration.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmFogI: Fog intensity forced during cataclysm weather. 0 disables extra fog, 1 is maximum fog.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmWind: Wind intensity forced during cataclysm weather. 0 disables extra wind, 1 is maximum wind.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmClou: Cloud intensity forced during cataclysm weather. Higher values make the storm look darker and heavier.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_CataclysmDesa: Visual desaturation during cataclysm weather. Higher values make the world look more bleak and storm-heavy.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableNormalH: When a normal horde event starts, the player character says a short random warning line above their head.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableCatacly: When a cataclysm horde event starts, the player character says a more intense random warning line above their head.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWanderi: Enables a separate passing horde event. The horde spawns on one side of the player and is attracted toward a point beyond the player area, so it may pass by if you stay quiet.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingExit: How far beyond the player the attraction point is placed. Higher values make the horde try to pass farther through the area instead of stopping near the player.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_WanderingSpre: How wide the wandering horde spawn formation is. Higher values make the horde look less like a single clump.
Sandbox_DynamicHordeEvents_EnableWanderi: When a wandering horde event starts, the player character says a short random line about staying quiet or letting the horde pass.
